# AUDIO PROFILE
One of the hundred survivors in a Cold War bunker under a Wiltshire hill: a man in his forties, a former bus driver.

## THE SCENE
The corridor behind the blast doors. A small robot at the door has just asked whether any of them would go back and change how it all went down, if they had the chance. Everyone answers at once.

### DIRECTOR'S NOTES
Style: heartfelt and certain, no hesitation; called out from the crowd.
Pace: quick, one breath.
Accent: West Country, as heard in Swindon. Never American.

### SAMPLE CONTEXT
One voice in a crowd all answering a question at the same moment.
